## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible result of this change.

## Validation

List the commands, environments, games, scenes, or manual checks used to verify
the change. Include relevant results without credentials or private data.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its behavior is documented.
- [ ] I ran the repository's documented validation checks.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, local environment files, or private data.
- [ ] Compatibility or performance claims are supported by reproducible evidence.
